description: This bar chart, from the paper "Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables," illustrates the macro f-score performance of two models, RECA (light pink) and GAIT_GAT (orange), across two frequency categories: "High" and "Medium" (labeled as "Medium Frequency" on the x-axis) and "Low". The vertical y-axis represents the "Macro f-score" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays three groups of bars: the first group corresponds to the "High" frequency category, showing a RECA score of 0.837 and a GAIT_GAT score of 0.877; the second group corresponds to the "Medium Frequency" category, showing a RECA score of 0.538 and a GAIT_GAT score of 0.609; and the third group corresponds to the "Low" frequency category, showing a RECA score of 0.114 and a GAIT_GAT score of 0.224. The bars are arranged in descending order of their values within each frequency group, with the "High" group being the tallest and the "Low" group the shortest. The chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating the color coding for each model.
